description: Read verified buying options for the exact product, destination, quantity and fulfillment mode. Empty offers mean no options verified for this request, not that the product does not exist. Choose an eligible store, then start_checkout with the same context; the buyer approves and pays in hosted checkout.
name: get_buying_options

color.description: Colour of the variant product_id names; null when it has none.

offer_count.description: How many offers this product has. search_catalog lists at most 5, orderable ones first; get_product lists all.

availability.description: NULL when we have no shelf read under 24 hours old (shelf_observed_at says when). Do not call it in or out of stock; when is_eligible_checkout is true it can still be ordered.

fulfillment.description: `local_delivery`: delivered from the shop. `concierge`: JENNi collects it from the shop and delivers it; buy it with start_checkout like any orderable offer. `ship_to_home`: shipped from the shop. `in_store_only`: the shop carries it, but it cannot be ordered through JENNi; tell the shopper to visit the shop. `pickup` is store-owned capability metadata, not a JENNi customer reservation/ready/handoff flow, and is never returned. These are not executable MCP methods: ordering happens on the storefront.

is_eligible_checkout.description: True: this offer can be ordered through JENNi; call start_checkout with it when the shopper wants to buy. start_checkout and the checkout page re-check the offer and say why if it can no longer be ordered, so do not ask the shopper to confirm stock or hours first. False: do not send the shopper to checkout for this offer. Nothing is charged until the shopper places the order on the checkout page.

note.description: The disclosure a shopper sees for this shop; relay it.

price.description: USD, e.g. "$12.50". Null when we hold no current price.

product_id.description: The exact variant this shop holds.

shelf_observed_at.description: When the shelf was last read. Null means never.

shelf_price.description: Store shelf price observed at the named store. Browse information only; not a checkout price. Use `price` and is_eligible_checkout for purchase.

url.description: Storefront page for this exact offer.

price.description: Headline price in USD; null when none is held.

shelf_price.description: Store shelf price observed at the named store. Browse information only; not a checkout price. Use `price` and is_eligible_checkout for purchase.

size.description: Size of the variant product_id names; null when it has none.

url.description: Storefront product page, where the buyer picks size/colour, checks out as a guest (email, no account) and pays. Null when no storefront is configured.

variants.description: Buyable size/colour variants. Give the shopper the variant url so the page opens on that choice. search_catalog lists at most 30; get_product lists all.

url.description: Storefront page opened on this variant.

title: Check price and delivery
